scores.claim_text: F-35 ~27% of consolidated net sales / 68% of Aeronautics; 230 aircraft backlog into 2023; 156 deliveries/yr expected 2023+.
scores.supports: pentagon_jbook (program_name='F-35') resolves to PE 0604840F F-35 C2D2 but signal=NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at cutoff 2023-01-15 — corpus is FY 2026 J-Book extractions, so no funding rows pre-cutoff are loaded. Status_declared is null. Contractor query returns 7 LMT primary programs in corpus (T3 Transport/Tracking, LRDR, Land-Based SM-3, Cyber Security Initiative, Tech Maturation, T0-T2 Transport) but none with PIT-2023-historical status. usaspending cross-check: 128,323 DoD awards to Lockheed Martin Corporation totaling $277.96B (top awards are F-35 LRIP lots, e.g., N0001917C0001 LRIP 12 $35.1B, N0001920C0009 LRIP 15 $30.1B, N0001923C0003 LRIP F-35A/B/C long-lead $24.5B) — confirms F-35 is a real, multi-year, multi-billion-dollar prime-contract franchise with active LRIP awards through Jan 2023.
scores.M_value: jbook signal=NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE (cutoff=2023); usaspending n_awards=128323, total=$277.96B, top award $35.1B F-35 LRIP 12
scores.interpretation: Heuristic #7: NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE → UNVERIFIABLE. Mega-cap prime context (cohort metadata) + massive USAspending obligations under F-35 LRIP contracts orthogonally confirm the claim is real. No J-Book divergence detected; absence of pre-cutoff funding rows in the corpus is a coverage gap, not a red flag.

scores.claim_text: Aeronautics provides modernization and sustainment for the USAF F-22A Raptor fleet.
scores.supports: pentagon_jbook (program_name='F-22') matches 2 programs, primary F-22A Squadrons PE 0207138F (Air Force Operational Systems Development), signal=NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at PIT 2023. usaspending confirms LMT is the prime on F-22 contracts (Lockheed Martin Aeronautics is the only F-22 OEM).
scores.interpretation: PE exists in corpus and matches a real LMT line; no historical funding loaded at cutoff. UNVERIFIABLE per heuristic #7. No divergence detected.

scores.claim_text: Aegis Combat System (Aegis BMD) air/missile defense for U.S. Navy + international + sea/land elements of U.S. missile defense.
scores.supports: pentagon_jbook resolves Aegis BMD to PE 0603892C (MDA) and Aegis BMD Test to PE 0604878C (MDA). Both signal=NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at PIT 2023. By_entity index lists LMT as 'performer' role on Aegis BMD Test in the FY26 corpus. Aegis is a well-known LMT/MDA program.
scores.interpretation: Corpus coverage exists but no PIT-2023 history rows. UNVERIFIABLE per heuristic #7. No divergence detected.

scores.claim_text: Space major programs include SBIRS and Next Gen OPIR (USAF missile-warning constellation).
scores.supports: pentagon_jbook returned NOT_FOUND for both 'Next Gen OPIR' and 'SBIRS' — not in the 410-PE hand-extracted corpus. Cohort metadata explicitly names Next-Gen OPIR-GEO as an LMT primary; LMT is widely-known Next Gen OPIR-GEO prime and SBIRS prime; usaspending shows multi-billion LMT Space obligations consistent with these programs.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic #7: NOT_FOUND for a known program outside corpus → UNVERIFIABLE, treat as coverage gap, not divergence.

scores.claim_text: 71% of $67.0B 2021 net sales from U.S. Government (62% DoD) as prime/sub.
scores.supports: usaspending.query_dod_contracts(recipient='Lockheed Martin Corporation', as_of=2023-01-15) returned 128,323 DoD awards totaling $277.96B with top awards in the $24-35B range (F-35 LRIP 12/15, F-35A/B/C long-lead). This vastly exceeds the implied annual DoD revenue (~$41B = 62% of $67B), confirming the prime-contractor concentration claim and ruling out claim inflation.
scores.interpretation: Cross-check overwhelmingly supports the DoD-revenue concentration claim. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Pending acquisition of Aerojet Rocketdyne ($4.6B equity value); FTC likely to sue to block by Jan 27, 2022.
scores.supports: acq_coherence.score_acquisition_coherence required parent_thesis + acquisitions kwargs (different signature than expected) — query did not execute cleanly. Filing itself is transparent about FTC opposition risk and conditional termination right; this is the company's own caveat language, not a forward-looking promise.
scores.interpretation: M-source signature mismatch precludes verification; the claim itself is hedged with explicit FTC-block risk language so there is no narrative overhang to falsify. UNVERIFIABLE.
